recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast portrait of a man in western attire positioned against a gritty, textured background featuring a stylized eagle emblem and layered ribbon banners containing typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the foreground right, graphic elements in the background left
Text contained within curved, dimensional ribbon banners
Rough, concrete-like texture overlaying the entire composition
Contrast between the realistic photographic subject and the flat, illustrative background art
coreInvariants: Red and white ribbon banners with black outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, slightly angled.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and cowboy hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes, down to the plaid shirt, then leftward to the stacked ribbon banners and up to the eagle illustration.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with dense graphic elements and heavy texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grays and desaturated blues (background and shirt).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright white of the hat/ribbon and the dark shadows; saturation is low except for the red banners.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sturdy, wide-set serifs and blackletter styles.
letterConstructionRules: Sharp, slab-like serifs for display text
Traditional blackletter/gothic structure for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to follow the curve of the ribbon banners
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a clean, modern slab serif and a traditional, ornate blackletter.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the sturdy, western slab-serif feel for the main title.
Matches the traditional gothic aesthetic of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, gray concrete-textured background. On the left side, place a large, black-line illustration of a bald eagle with wings spread. Overlay three curved ribbon banners (top red, middle white, bottom red) with black outlines and internal hatching for depth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a high-resolution portrait of a man wearing a cowboy hat and a blue/white plaid shirt on the right side, partially overlapping the banners. Add the main title in a black slab-serif font on the top two banners and the artist name in a blackletter font on the bottom banner, following the curve of the ribbons.

verificationChecks: Text follows the arc of the banners
Texture is applied consistently across background and graphics
Subject is sharp and well-lit compared to the graphic background
Color palette is strictly limited to red, white, black, and gray

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between photo and graphic
avoid: Clean, flat vector look without texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cowboy hat doesn't merge into the background eagle
Check that the text warp looks natural within the ribbons
Verify the grit texture doesn't obscure the subject's face
Confirm the hierarchy: Subject > Main Title > Artist Name
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rugged male portrait in western wear with a multi-tiered ribbon banner and patriotic animal iconography, all unified by a heavy distressed concrete texture and a limited red/white/black palette.
